explication: GoSearch is a command-line OSINT tool that checks a username across websites, identity services, GitHub, and breach-data sources, then displays and saves findings. The principal workflow begins in the CLI, loads the website catalog, performs concurrent profile checks, and then runs enrichment and credential searches. The graph preserves README-described capabilities, including optional BreachDirectory lookup and hash cracking. Some GitHub and search implementations are represented at their exact directory or file paths because their source was not fully sampled; edges are limited to shown calls or documented behavior.
